description: Fetch creator-facing profile details for a connected account: display name, username, profile picture, bio, follower/following counts, and platform-specific publishing capabilities (e.g. TikTok privacy levels, duet/stitch permissions). Use this before building a post UI so defaults and options match what the platform allows for this account. Use social_api_list_accounts to find the account_id.
name: social_api_get_creator_info
title: Get Creator Info
